annotations.text:
The screen a researcher sees most often. 29 and 30 August had zero amendments —
real data, not a placeholder. States the absence as a finding, then gives the
quiet somewhere to go: 751 completed trials with results worth reading.

Leads with the strongest amendment a trial can carry: its results are published.
TrialLens did not store that field until 2 Sept — every one of these used to read
as "amended, but we can't see what".

The alarm REPLACES the page rather than sitting above it.
A stale feed under a small warning still reads as current — that is the failure being designed out.
